work_items.title: SQL translation spike — percentile_cont, heatmap, cohort, shift-clamp, bounding-box
acceptance_criteria: percentile_cont(0.5)/(0.9) WITHIN GROUP over EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (assigned_at - created_at)) per Prague bucket translates; keyless record uses snake_case aliases (p50_seconds, p90_seconds, bucket). Contract: every SLA percentile metric filters to rows where BOTH interval endpoints are non-null before aggregation (WHERE assigned_at IS NOT NULL AND created_at IS NOT NULL etc.) — NULL-endpoint rows excluded, never fed as NULL epochs; fixture includes a NULL-later-endpoint row.
Demand heatmap GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR ...), EXTRACT(DOW ...) at Prague TZ translates to (hour, dow, count).
Cohort triangle grouping via date_trunc('month', ... AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Prague') translates.
driver_shifts per-hour-bucket online-seconds clamp in SQL translates OR a documented in-memory-over-aggregates fallback is written into the spike file.

Bounding-box zone attribution FILTER (WHERE pickup_lat/lng BETWEEN ...) translates; the C#-side bbox derivation covers BOTH ZoneService shapes: Polygon (min/max lat/lng of vertices) AND Circle (center +/- radius-in-degrees; lat delta = radiusMeters/111320, lng delta = radiusMeters/(111320*cos(centerLat)) scaled by cos(lat)). Fixture includes one Circle + one Polygon zone.
week/month bucket variants (date_trunc) translate.
percentile matches hand-computed values on odd + even counts (AC#2).

work_items.schedule_note: Chained after WI-09 to serialize shared docs/api.md + allowlist edits; also needs WI-01's WeeklyDigestMarker table.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/admin/analytics (SuperAdminOnly, IgnoreQueryFilters documented at query site): per-fleet rides+revenue this/last month + MoM delta, active drivers, active customers, SMS count + est cost, last order timestamp, 12-week rides sparkline, health flag (growing/stable/declining/inactive), platform totals row.

WeeklyDigestJob: internal RunTickAsync shell, PeriodicTimer via injected TimeProvider, Monday 06:00 Europe/Prague; per active fleet last ISO week vs prior; Web Push via IPushSender.SendAsync (Task<PushSendResult>) to FleetAdmin users; idempotent per (fleet, ISO week) via WeeklyDigestMarker; zero-activity fleets skipped; Czech text, no PII beyond top driver first name; registered in AddJobs().

Per-recipient push outcome handling: a PushSendOutcome.Gone (410, subscription auto-deleted by sender) or any send failure is logged (no PII — fleet id + outcome + counts only) and does NOT abort the fleet's remaining recipients nor block the idempotency-marker insert; the WeeklyDigestMarker is written once per (fleet, ISO week) regardless of partial send failures.
Same ISO week processed twice sends exactly one push per fleet (AC#8); digest numbers match overview endpoint for that week (AC#8).
Route added to allowlist; docs/api.md regenerated; logs fleet id + counts only (no PII).
